fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The ANC says its special NEC meeting neither considered nor was asked to consider the recall of the ANC President, that resignation was not on the table, and that the NEC reaffirmed "full and continuing support" for "the President of the African National Congress, Comrade Cyril Ramaphosa", as leader of the movement.

locator.section: Paragraphs beginning "I now wish to put a matter" and "The National Executive Committee of the African National Congress"

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The same statement says the ANC President holds office on a mandate from the branches, which "elected him to a five-year term at the 55th National Conference at Nasrec in December 2022", and that the next National Conference is in December 2027.

locator.section: Paragraph beginning "The President of the African National Congress holds his office"
